nome_jp: 幻獣竜機ボルパンサー
testo:
Speed Attacker
Powered Breaker
■ While attacking, this creature gets +3000 power for each of your other Dragons or Dreammate creatures.
■ Whenever this creature attacks, if you have 5 or more other Dragons or Dreammate creatures, destroy all your opponent's creatures that have less power than this creature.
